title: JANUS Tear Polynomial Quotient Conjecture

source_bridge.computational_translation: A compact independently checkable invariant condensed from one or more conflicting residual states.
source_bridge.metaphor_boundary: Tear chemistry and salt conductivity are not evidence of digital emotional storage or computational speedup.

formal_candidate.input: CNF formula F and conflicting partial assignment alpha
formal_candidate.output: tear tau plus a polynomially checkable derivation
requirements: tau is extracted and verified in polynomial time
the total non-redundant tear volume is polynomial
equal tear signatures permit satisfiability-preserving residual-state merging
tear saturation produces a SAT witness or a polynomially checkable UNSAT certificate
formal_candidate.conditional_consequence: If one deterministic algorithm satisfies every requirement on every CNF of length L with polynomial total work, then SAT is in P and therefore P=NP.

first_positive_result.family: two-component toroidal Tseitin systems inherited from C018
first_positive_result.tear: one component-charge parity bit per connected component
first_positive_result.result: The global tear decides satisfiability for this family while every tested bounded-local charge signature multiset remains identical.

main_barriers: restricted clause tears reduce to known conflict learning without a polynomial worst-case theorem
bounded-local tears fail on C018 toroidal twins
exact residual canonicalization may hide formula equivalence or SAT
expressive tears may be hard to verify soundly
the number of distinct useful tears may remain exponential
family-specific algebraic invariants do not imply a universal CNF invariant language
parallel latency gains do not erase total work, energy, or communication cost

swarm_roles.HOLOCRON: canonicalize, deduplicate, preserve provenance, and measure state merging

admission_gate: separate the mechanism from ordinary learned clauses
test C018 twins and non-Tseitin crafted CNFs
record at least one positive compression result beyond component parity
charge total generation, verification, memory, communication, and witness-recovery work
claim_boundary: This proposal isolates a conditional route to P=NP and one exact family-specific compression result. It does not prove a universal tear basis, SAT in P, or P=NP.
